name: skeleton
title: Skeleton
description: Placeholder shapes that stand in for content while it loads.

examples.name: skeleton-text
examples.title: Text
examples.description: SkeletonText follows the surrounding font size and line height.

props.name: inlineSize
props.description: Width. Numbers are pixels; strings are any CSS length.

props.name: blockSize
props.description: Height. Numbers are pixels; strings are any CSS length.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius from the theme's shape tokens.

props.name: circle
props.description: A circle; inlineSize sets the diameter (default 40px).

props.name: lines
props.description: Number of lines; the last one is 60% wide.

notes: Skeletons are aria-hidden. Put aria-busy="true" on the loading region and announce completion if it matters.
The shimmer runs only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference and sweeps in the reading direction.

do: Match the layout of the content that will replace it, so nothing jumps.
dont: Don't skeleton things that never load (labels, headings you already know).
Don't mix skeletons and spinners for the same content.
